object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Ask Mellon to check each of these folders as a repository root: a folder outside any git work tree; a subfolder of a git work tree; the root of a repository with one commit that git records as shallow; the root of a repository whose repository format version is 99, which git can't open. Expected: each folder is refused, with a reason that says, in turn, that the folder is not inside a git repository, is not the root of its git work tree, is a shallow clone, and is a repository git can't open.
